Sanskrit sutras: source review

All 3983 sutras, from ashtadhyayi.com's data (credited). 55 carry a flag: a field where another source differs. The restricted compilation's text is not reproduced here; its disagreements are recorded by sutra and field. Every sutra has an issue link to zistgah/tajziya. Translations, interpretations, the implementing code and more scripts arrive as work packets: pick one up.
